paragraphs.text: Leocadio Zúñiga Ugalde was arrested in Arrest GDL-11-01 on 2011-01-12. Liga del Cedro Lunar was linked to Arrest GDL-11-01 on 2011-01-12. Arrest GDL-11-01 occurred at Guadalajara on 2011-01-12. A property registry extract reviewed by the reporting office, together with interviews with a registry clerk, places Zúñiga, a lieutenant for Liga del Cedro Lunar known to the crews as El Sapo Verde, at a Guadalajara property at the time federal forces arrested him there. The clerk stated that the property had been transferred twice in the preceding year through nominees and that the transfers were being examined for undervaluation. The extract shows the property as a residential compound on the western edge of the city with a separate warehouse, and the clerk stated that the warehouse had been inspected once by municipal authorities without result.

Everardo Montemayor Ruvalcaba led Liga del Cedro Lunar from 2010-12-17 until 2018-04-26. The clerk identified Montemayor as the person on whose behalf the property was held and characterized him as the head of the network. The reporting office notes that the clerk dated the start of Montemayor's control of the network to the time of the second property transfer, which is later than other reporting places it. The discrepancy is reported as given and has not been resolved.

The reporting office assesses the registry extract as reliable on ownership history and the clerk as having incidental knowledge of the network's figures. The source reporting was received through the standard liaison channel for this agency. The reporting office will compare the leadership date given here with other agency reporting before the discrepancy is reflected in any assessment. Earlier reporting on the same network is available from the originating office on request.
